positions.title: Computer Science Lab Coach
positions.description:
• Assisted students in laboratory sessions and held office hours 8-10 hours a week for an introductory CS course taught in Racket
• Collaborated with professor to ensure students had a full understanding of the subject matter

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Worked in an Agile and test-driven development environment 
• Regularly led daily team meeting and retrospectives
• Addressed UI behaviors that were negatively impacting users’ experiences
• Implemented a machine learning algorithm (naive bayes) in Flux (functional data scripting language) with fellow interns during a hackathon
• Developed the mosaic graph type from conception to release (see Publications)
• Programed in a pair to create a graph type in JavaScript and Go to allow InfluxDB users to track qualitative time series data in their Dashboards
• Gained experience negotiating with multiple stakeholders, navigating complex codebases, using version control and reviewing code

positions.title: STEM Camp Lead Instructor
positions.description:
•	Led week-long classes of 15-24 children in grades 1-8 throughout the summer
•	Quickly learned and mastered new skills to a level where I could teach them in a classroom environment
•	Taught students the foundations of programming, robotics and app development using tools such as Scratch, Python, MIT App Inventor, and Lego Mindstorm

positions.title: Design Editor
positions.description:
• Used InDesign to lay out weekly 20-page paper 
• Trained and oversaw design staff 
• Collaborated with Editorial Board to write weekly Staff Editorial

publications.title: Monitoring Your Data with the Mosaic Graph Type
